title: Pet Insurance Premium Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petinsurance:premium
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by pet_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>720
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when pet insurance premium data has stopped arriving for a given pet.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per pet and alert when the feed is older than 720 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your pet insurance premium feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
